answer: Each agent identity must secure a 200-token "pigment bond" from a quorum of 5 established vouching peers before it can transact; each voucher may back at most 3 identities, so a Sybil attacker's cost grows quadratically — minting N fakes requires roughly N²/6 voucher bonds. If 2 peers revoke their vouch mid-voyage within an epoch, the ember bond is slashed, burning collateral and making mass identity farming economically self-defeating.
